title: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic pretraining for VLAs
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are fundamentally bottlenecked by the scarcity of expert demonstrations -- triplets of observations, instructions, and actions that are costly to collect at scale. We argue that this bottleneck stems from conflating two distinct learning objectives: acquiring physical competence (how to move) and acquiring semantic alignment (what to do). Crucially, only the latter requires language supervision. Building on this Decomposition Hypothesis, we propose Task-Agnostic Pretraining (TAP), a two-stage framework that first learns transferable motor priors from cheap, unlabeled interaction data -- including discarded off-task trajectories and autonomous robot play -- via a self-supervised Inverse Dynamics objective. A lightweight second stage then grounds these priors in language using minimal expert data. On the SIMPLER benchmark, TAP matches models trained on over 1M expert trajectories while using orders of magnitude less labeled data, yielding a 10% absolute gain over standard behavior cloning. On a real-world WidowX platform, TAP retains 25% success under camera perturbations where internet-scale baselines collapse to 0%, demonstrating that task-agnostic pretraining produces robust, transferable physical representations and offers a scalable path forward for Embodied AI.
tldr: Proposes a two-stage framework that first learns motor priors from unlabeled interaction data via inverse dynamics, then grounds them in language with minimal expert data, achieving strong VLA performance with orders of magnitude less labeled data.
tldr_zh: 提出两阶段框架，先通过逆动力学从无标签交互数据学习运动先验，再用极少专家数据将其与语言对齐，以数量级更少的标注数据实现强大的VLA性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的核心瓶颈在于专家演示数据的稀缺——即观测、指令和动作的三元组，这些数据难以大规模采集。我们认为，这一瓶颈源于将两个不同的学习目标混为一谈：获取物理能力（如何移动）与获取语义对齐（做什么）。关键在于，只有后者需要语言监督。基于这一分解假说，我们提出任务无关预训练（TAP）——一个两阶段框架：首先通过自监督逆动力学目标，从廉价的无标签交互数据（包括丢弃的离任务轨迹和自主机器人探索）中学习可迁移的运动先验；第二阶段则利用极少量专家数据，将这些先验与语言进行轻量级对齐。在SIMPLER基准测试中，TAP与在超过100万条专家轨迹上训练的模型性能相当，但所用标注数据量减少数个数量级，在标准行为克隆基础上实现10%的绝对提升。在真实世界的WidowX平台上，当相机扰动导致互联网规模基线模型成功率骤降至0%时，TAP仍保持25%的成功率。这表明，任务无关预训练可产生鲁棒且可迁移的物理表征，为具身人工智能提供了一条可扩展的发展路径。

title: The Moving Eye: Enhancing VLA Spatial Generalization via Hybrid Dynamic Data Collection
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable promise in generalized robotic manipulation. However, their spatial generalization remains fragile. We argue that simply increasing the number of viewpoints is insufficient. Models often fall into the trap of Shortcut Learning, latching onto spurious correlations (e.g., fixed relative poses between objects or between the camera and robot base) rather than learning true spatial relationships. In this work, we propose a data-centric solution to enhance VLA spatial generalization. We utilize a dual-arm setup where one arm performs manipulation while the other serves as a mobile environmental camera. We systematically evaluate three data distribution patterns: Fixed, Multi-Fixed, and Moving Views. Our findings reveal that a hybrid strategy, combining continuous camera motion with diverse static viewpoints, yields the best performance by substantially reducing spurious correlations while maintaining training stability. Our experiments demonstrate that this strategy mitigates spurious correlations, enabling VLAs to generalize to unseen camera poses and object configurations where simply adding more static viewpoints fails. Crucially, we reveal that the susceptibility to shortcut learning and the struggle with spatial generalization are universal characteristics shared across diverse architectures. Consequently, all evaluated models (ACT, Diffusion, and VLA models including Pi0 and Gr00t) benefit significantly from our mixed data strategy.
tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid dynamic data collection strategy—combining continuous camera motion with diverse static viewpoints—to mitigate shortcut learning and improve spatial generalization in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种混合动态数据收集策略，结合连续相机运动与多样化静态视角，以减轻捷径学习并提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中的空间泛化能力。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作中展现出显著潜力，但其空间泛化能力仍显脆弱。我们认为，单纯增加视角数量并不足够。模型常陷入捷径学习的陷阱，执着于虚假相关性（例如物体之间的固定相对位姿，或相机与机器人基座之间的固定相对位姿），而非学习真正的空间关系。为此，本文提出一种以数据为中心的解决方案，以增强VLA的空间泛化能力。我们采用双机械臂设置，其中一只臂执行操作任务，另一只臂作为移动环境相机。我们系统评估了三种数据分布模式：固定视角、多固定视角与移动视角。研究结果表明，将连续相机运动与多样化静态视角相结合的混合策略，通过显著减少虚假相关性同时保持训练稳定性，实现了最佳性能。实验证明，该策略能够缓解虚假相关性问题，使VLA能够泛化至未见过的相机位姿与物体配置，而单纯增加静态视角则无法实现。关键的是，我们揭示了捷径学习易感性与空间泛化困难是跨不同架构的共有特征。因此，所有被评估的模型（包括ACT、扩散模型以及Pi0和Gr00t等VLA模型）均从我们的混合数据策略中显著受益。

title: VLAFlow: A Unified Training Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models via Co-training and Future Latent Alignment
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently advanced robotic manipulation, yet the effects of different robot-data pre-training paradigms remain difficult to compare because existing models often differ in architecture, data, action space, and evaluation protocol. We present VLAFlow (Vision-Language-Action Flow), a unified flow-matching framework for controlled comparison of VLA training objectives. Using a heterogeneous robot corpus, OXEMix, containing approximately 5,000 hours of data from DROID, OpenX-Embodiment, OpenX-Augmented, and RoboCOIN, we evaluate four paradigms under the same pi0-style architecture, shared VLM backbone, action expert, and 14-dimensional action space: action-only modeling (MindPI), language-supervised co-training (MindLPI), future latent alignment (MindWPI), and their combination (MindLWPI). Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv show that action-only pre-training is sensitive to heterogeneous data. In contrast, language supervision helps preserve vision-language generalization, while future latent alignment improves state-transition and action-outcome modeling. By combining both signals, MindLWPI achieves the most stable overall transfer performance across benchmarks. These results suggest a meta-action space view: language and future latent representations provide complementary intermediate constraints that make heterogeneous action supervision smoother and more transferable.
tldr: VLAFlow presents a unified flow-matching framework for comparing VLA training paradigms, showing that combining language supervision with future latent alignment improves heterogeneous robot-data transfer.
tldr_zh: VLAFlow提出了一个统一的流匹配框架来比较VLA训练范式，表明结合语言监督和未来潜在对齐可提升异质机器人数据的迁移性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）近期推动了机器人操作技术的发展，但由于现有模型在架构、数据、动作空间和评估协议上往往存在差异，不同机器人数据预训练范式的影响仍难以比较。我们提出VLAFlow（视觉-语言-动作流），一个统一的流匹配框架，用于对VLA训练目标进行受控比较。利用包含来自DROID、OpenX-Embodiment、OpenX-Augmented和RoboCOIN约5000小时数据的异构机器人语料库OXEMix，我们在相同的pi0风格架构、共享的VLM主干、动作专家以及14维动作空间下评估了四种范式：纯动作建模（MindPI）、语言监督协同训练（MindLPI）、未来潜在对齐（MindWPI）及其组合（MindLWPI）。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和SimplerEnv上的实验表明，纯动作预训练对异构数据敏感。相比之下，语言监督有助于保持视觉-语言泛化能力，而未来潜在对齐则改善了状态转换和动作结果建模。通过结合这两种信号，MindLWPI在多个基准测试中实现了最稳定且最优的整体迁移性能。这些结果表明了一种元动作空间视角：语言和未来潜在表征提供了互补的中间约束，使得异构动作监督更加平滑且更具可迁移性。

title: VT-WAM: Visual-Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires policies to react to local deformation, pressure, slip, and friction, yet these cues are temporally sparse and often invisible in visual observations. Existing visual-tactile policies usually feed tactile observations directly into action prediction, but rarely model tactile deformation dynamics during action generation. In this paper, we introduce VT-WAM, a Visual-Tactile World Action Model that jointly learns future visual prediction, tactile deformation prediction, and action prediction within a unified flow matching framework. In particular, VT-WAM introduces (1) Asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) attention to bridge a first-frame visual anchor with temporal tactile dynamics, and (2) contact-gated Action-Visual-Tactile Attention Guidance (AVTAG) to encourage action queries to rely on tactile evidence during contact phases. Across six real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, VT-WAM achieves a 71.67% average success rate, outperforming Fast-WAM by 26.67% and OmniVTLA by 35.84%. Ablations demonstrate that modeling tactile deformation dynamics and guiding contact-phase tactile attention are both important for contact-rich tasks. Project website: https://vt-wam.github.io/.
tldr: VT-WAM introduces a unified flow matching framework that jointly models visual prediction, tactile deformation dynamics, and action prediction for contact-rich manipulation, achieving significant improvements on real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: VT-WAM 提出了一个统一的流匹配框架，联合建模视觉预测、触觉变形动力学和动作预测，在真实世界的接触密集操作任务上取得了显著改进。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作要求策略对局部形变、压力、滑动和摩擦力做出反应，然而这些线索在时间上是稀疏的，并且通常在视觉观测中不可见。现有的视觉-触觉策略通常直接将触觉观测数据输入动作预测模型，但很少在动作生成过程中对触觉形变动力学进行建模。本文提出了VT-WAM——一种视觉-触觉世界动作模型，能够在统一的流匹配框架内联合学习未来视觉预测、触觉形变预测和动作预测。具体而言，VT-WAM引入了：（1）非对称混合变换器（MoT）注意力机制，用于桥接首帧视觉锚点与时序触觉动力学；（2）接触门控的动作-视觉-触觉注意力引导（AVTAG），以鼓励动作查询在接触阶段依赖触觉证据。在六项真实世界接触丰富的操作任务中，VT-WAM实现了71.67%的平均成功率，比Fast-WAM高出26.67%，比OmniVTLA高出35.84%。消融实验表明，对触觉形变动力学进行建模以及引导接触阶段的触觉注意力，对于接触密集任务均至关重要。项目网站：https://vt-wam.github.io/。

title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
summary: Embodied AI models now span vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs), but practical deployment remains fragmented across model-specific Python stacks, backend assumptions, and robot-side glue code, especially on heterogeneous edge devices. Existing inference runtimes are designed mainly for request-response serving and therefore do not satisfy the runtime contract of embodied deployment: multi-rate execution inside closed-loop control, latency-first batch-1 inference on heterogeneous hardware, and extensible embodied interfaces beyond fixed token I/O. We present Embodied.cpp, a portable C++ inference runtime for embodied models. Based on an architectural analysis of representative VLA models and WAMs, Embodied.cpp captures a shared execution path and organizes it into five layers: input adapters, sequence builders, backbone execution, head plugins, and deployment adapters. The runtime provides modular multi-rate execution, latency-first fused inference, and extensible operator and I/O support, enabling deployment across heterogeneous devices, robots, and simulators through one backend abstraction. We evaluate Embodied.cpp on two VLA models, HY-VLA and pi0.5, and on a preliminary WAM benchmark using a LingBot-VA Transformer block. The VLA deployments achieve successful closed-loop execution with 100.0% and 91.0% task success rates, respectively. The WAM benchmark reduces block memory from 312.2 MiB to 88.1 MiB. These results show that Embodied.cpp improves deployment efficiency while preserving high accuracy across diverse embodied model architectures.
tldr: Embodied.cpp is a portable C++ inference runtime for VLA and world-action models, enabling efficient closed-loop deployment on heterogeneous robots with multi-rate execution and fused inference.
tldr_zh: Embodied.cpp 是一个便携式C++推理运行时，支持VLA和世界动作模型，通过多速率执行和融合推理在异构机器人上实现高效的闭环部署。
summary_zh: 具身AI模型现已涵盖视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界-动作模型（WAM），但其实际部署仍因模型专属的Python技术栈、后端假设以及机器人端胶合代码而碎片化，尤其是在异构边缘设备上。现有推理运行时主要面向请求-响应式服务设计，无法满足具身部署的运行时合约：闭环控制内的多速率执行、异构硬件上以延迟优先的批量大小为1的推理，以及超越固定令牌I/O的可扩展具身接口。我们提出Embodied.cpp，一个面向具身模型的可移植C++推理运行时。基于对代表性VLA模型和WAM的架构分析，Embodied.cpp提炼出共享执行路径，并将其组织为五层：输入适配器、序列构建器、骨干执行、头部插件以及部署适配器。该运行时提供模块化多速率执行、延迟优先的融合推理，以及可扩展算子与I/O支持，通过单一后端抽象实现跨异构设备、机器人与仿真器的部署。我们在两个VLA模型（HY-VLA与pi0.5）上，以及基于LingBot-VA Transformer模块的初步WAM基准上评估了Embodied.cpp。VLA部署实现了成功的闭环执行，任务成功率分别为100.0%和91.0%。WAM基准将模块内存从312.2 MiB降至88.1 MiB。这些结果表明，Embodied.cpp在提升部署效率的同时，能够在多种具身模型架构中保持高精度。

title: Controllable Sim Agents with Behavior Latents
summary: Realistic traffic simulation requires agents that imitate logged behavior and can also be steered along interpretable axes. Such controllability enables engineers to isolate variables, reproduce specific edge cases, and test autonomous systems without real-world risk. We introduce Controllable Neural Variational Agents (CNeVA), a controllable simulated-agent framework that learns to infer a per-agent Gaussian behavior latent from per-channel discounted returns via a closed-form conjugate variational update, conditioning a rectified-flow trajectory generator trained on a mixed channel-mask curriculum for classifier-free guidance. To tackle scarcity in reward signals, we propose soft eligibility gates that replace hard binary thresholds with smooth exponential decay, preserving the gradient signal for near-threshold agents. On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, CNeVA attains competitive realism on the benchmark while exposing per-channel controllability that the higher-ranked imitation models lack. Speed- and acceleration-based steering produces monotone responses without stall-induced reward hacking. Safety controllability is monotone and substantial with the introduction of soft eligibility. We manage to achieve steerable map compliance under a context-residual return measure. Furthermore, our experiment demonstrates that steering metrics must be read alongside physical-plausibility guardrails to avoid reward-hacking confounds.
tldr: This paper introduces Controllable Neural Variational Agents (CNeVA), a framework for controllable traffic simulation that infers behavior latents and uses rectified-flow trajectory generation, achieving competitive realism while enabling interpretable steering of agent behaviors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了可控神经变分代理（CNeVA），一种用于可控交通模拟的框架，通过推断行为潜变量并使用修正流轨迹生成，在实现竞争性真实感的同时支持对代理行为的可解释控制。
summary_zh: 真实交通仿真要求智能体既能模仿记录的行为，又能在可解释的轴向上被引导。这种可控性使工程师能够隔离变量、复现特定边缘案例，并在无现实风险的情况下测试自动驾驶系统。我们提出可控神经变分智能体（CNeVA），这是一种可控的仿真智能体框架，通过闭式共轭变分更新，从每个通道的折扣回报中学习推断每个智能体的高斯行为潜变量，并基于混合通道掩码课程训练整流流轨迹生成器，实现无分类器引导。为解决奖励信号的稀疏性问题，我们提出软资格门控，用平滑指数衰减替代硬性二元阈值，为接近阈值的智能体保留梯度信号。在Waymo开放运动数据集上，CNeVA在基准测试中达到具有竞争力的真实度，同时展现出排名更高的模仿模型所缺乏的逐通道可控性。基于速度和加速度的引导产生单调响应，且不会因卡滞引发奖励破解。引入软门控后，安全性可控性呈现单调且显著的特征。我们成功实现了在上下文残差回报度量下的可引导地图合规性。此外，实验表明，引导指标必须与物理合理性防护栏共同解读，以避免奖励破解的混淆效应。

title: WorldSample: Closed-loop Real-robot RL with World Modelling
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can overcome the demonstration-coverage limitation of imitation learning (IL) by allowing robots to improve through trial-and-error interaction beyond the states observed in demonstrations. However, deploying RL on real robots remains constrained by high interaction costs, since each physical rollout is costly and reflects only one realized action-outcome path. To address this challenge, we propose WorldSample, a physically grounded data augmentation framework for real-robot RL that closes a real-synthetic loop between physical rollouts, world-model generation, and policy improvement. Grounded on real rollouts, WorldSample generates high-fidelity synthetic transitions through a post-trained world model, which greatly lowers the visual hallucination. Specifically, rather than simply using these transitions as real-world experience, WorldSample introduces Policy-Paced Learning (PPL) to regulate the training process through sample selection and scheduling, balancing useful augmentation against value overestimation and mitigating the hallucination-induced noise. Experiments on robot manipulation tasks involving contact-rich and precise tasks show that WorldSample improves policy success rate by 28% while reducing training steps by 59% compared with baselines. Furthermore, WorldSample improves world model visual fidelity by 19.4dB in PSNR and 0.47 in SSIM over demonstration-only post-training, validating the effectiveness of the real-synthetic loop for both policy and world model performance.
tldr: WorldSample introduces a closed-loop framework combining real-robot rollouts, world-model generation, and policy improvement for data augmentation in RL, achieving significant gains in manipulation success rate and training efficiency.
tldr_zh: WorldSample 提出了一种闭环框架，结合真实机器人滚动、世界模型生成和策略改进进行数据增强，在操作任务上显著提升了成功率和训练效率。
summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）能够克服模仿学习（IL）在示范覆盖范围上的局限性，允许机器人通过与示范状态之外的观测进行试错交互来改进自身性能。然而，将RL部署于真实机器人仍受限于高昂的交互成本，因为每次物理部署不仅代价高昂，且仅能反映单一实现的动作-结果路径。为解决这一挑战，我们提出WorldSample——一种基于物理实体的数据增强框架，专为真实机器人强化学习设计，通过闭环连接物理部署、世界模型生成与策略改进三个环节。该框架基于真实部署数据，通过后训练的世界模型生成高保真合成转移样本，显著降低了视觉幻觉。具体而言，WorldSample并非简单地将这些转移样本作为真实世界经验使用，而是引入策略节奏学习（PPL）机制，通过样本选择与调度规范训练过程，在有效数据增强与价值估计过高的权衡间取得平衡，并缓解幻觉引发的噪声干扰。在涉及密集接触与高精度操作的机器人操控任务实验中，WorldSample相较基线方法将策略成功率提升28%，同时减少59%的训练步数。此外，相较于仅依赖示范数据的后训练，WorldSample将世界模型的视觉保真度在PSNR指标上提升19.4dB、SSIM指标上提升0.47，验证了该真实-合成闭环对策略与世界模型性能的双重有效性。

title: LIME: Learning Intent-aware Camera Motion from Egocentric Video
summary: Autonomous robots often need to move their camera before they can act: to inspect an object, reveal an occluded region, or obtain a view that responds to a user's intent. While vision-language navigation translates instructions to base motion and vision-language-action policies map instructions to manipulation actions, language-conditioned camera motion remains comparatively underexplored as a first-class action. We formulate language-conditioned camera motion generation: given a current RGB observation and a free-form natural-language intent, predict a relative target camera pose for the next observation. This task is inherently non-trivial: viewpoint changes are driven by latent perceptual intentions, and a valid motion may operate at different semantic granularity, from entering a room to looking around a corner, inspecting a visible object, or revealing an occluded detail. To model this structure, we mine multi-intention camera-motion supervision from egocentric video, pairing plausible intents and observation-gain descriptions with relative SE(3) target poses. We propose LIME, a vision-language camera-motion generator that combines an auto-regressive observation-gain output with a continuous flow-matching pose head. This design lets the model jointly predict what the next view should reveal while representing multi-hypothesis target views. Across experiments and downstream robotic tasks, we show that LIME can learn to actively choose camera poses from passive human video, turning ordinary egocentric recordings into supervision for intent-aware active perception.
tldr: LIME generates language-conditioned camera motions from egocentric video by jointly predicting what the next view should reveal and a continuous target pose, enabling intent-aware active perception for robots.
tldr_zh: LIME从第一人称视频中学习语言控制的相机运动，联合预测下一个视角应显示的内容和连续目标位姿，实现机器人意图驱动的主动感知。
summary_zh: 自主机器人往往需要先移动相机再采取行动：检查物体、揭示被遮挡区域，或获取符合用户意图的视角。虽然视觉-语言导航将指令转化为基础运动，视觉-语言-动作策略将指令映射为操控动作，但以语言为条件的相机运动作为一类核心动作仍相对缺乏研究。我们提出语言条件驱动的相机运动生成任务：给定当前RGB观测图像和自由形式的自然语言意图，预测下一观测对应的相对目标相机位姿。该任务本质具有挑战性：视角变化由潜在感知意图驱动，且有效运动可在不同语义粒度上执行——从进入房间到环视角落、检查可见物体或揭示被遮挡细节。为建模这种结构，我们从第一人称视频中挖掘包含多重意图的相机运动监督信息，将合理的意图与观测增益描述同相对SE(3)目标位姿配对。我们提出LIME——一种视觉-语言相机运动生成器，其结合自回归的观测增益输出与连续流匹配位姿头。该设计使模型能联合预测下一视角应揭示的内容，同时表示多假设的目标视角。通过系列实验与下游机器人任务，我们证明LIME能够从被动人类视频中学习主动选择相机位姿，将普通的第一人称录像转化为意图感知主动感知的监督信号。

title: ACID: Action Consistency via Inverse Dynamics for Planning with World Models
summary: Decision-time planning with action-conditioned world models has become a popular paradigm for embodied control. However, the standard planning cost judges a candidate solely by how close its predicted terminal state lies to the goal, leaving the realizability of the intermediate transitions unchecked -- a predicted trajectory can look convincing while the environment rollout drifts away from it. In this paper, we propose ACID, a decision-time planning framework that introduces cycle action consistency: the action inferred backward from a predicted transition by an inverse dynamics model should recover the one that was conditioned on. We fold this per-step residual into the planning cost via a scale-invariant adaptive weight. Across four action-conditioned world models and six tasks spanning rigid and deformable manipulation, articulated control, and visual navigation, ACID consistently improves planning and matches the baseline's accuracy with substantially less planning compute.
tldr: ACID introduces cycle action consistency via inverse dynamics to improve decision-time planning with action-conditioned world models, enhancing planning accuracy and efficiency across manipulation and navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: ACID通过逆动力学引入循环动作一致性，改进了基于动作条件世界模型的决策时规划，在操作和导航任务中提升了规划精度和效率。
summary_zh: 基于动作条件世界模型的决策时规划已成为具身控制领域的主流范式。然而，标准规划成本仅通过候选方案的预测终止状态与目标的接近程度进行评估，忽略了中间过渡过程的可实现性——预测轨迹可能看似合理，但实际环境推演却会偏离该轨迹。本文提出ACID决策时规划框架，引入循环动作一致性：由逆动力学模型从预测过渡中反向推断得到的动作，应能还原出作为条件输入的动作。我们通过尺度不变自适应权重将这种逐步骤残差纳入规划成本。在涵盖刚体及可变形操作、关节控制、视觉导航的四种动作条件世界模型与六项任务中，ACID持续提升规划性能，并在显著降低规划计算量的情况下保持与基线相当的精度。

title: HEFT: Heavy-Payload Full-size Humanoid Teleoperation with Privileged Motion Guidance and Windowed Payload Curriculum
summary: General motion tracking and teleoperation offer a promising path to scalable humanoid skill acquisition, yet most existing frameworks are validated on compact platforms or without real payload interaction, leaving full-size humanoids with real payloads largely unexplored. Scaling to full-size humanoids introduces two compounding challenges: their larger inertia and tighter balance margins make tracking highly sensitive to noise, drift, and retargeting errors from commodity VR trackers, while their payload potential remains largely underutilized. We present HEFT, a heavy-payload full-size humanoid teleoperation framework that addresses both challenges. HEFT learns from deployable noisy VR references with physically plausible reconstructed references through Privileged Motion Guidance (PMG), and uses a Windowed Payload Curriculum (WPC) with expert-guided payload caps to acquire robust heavy-payload tracking. We deploy HEFT on L7, a 175cm, 65kg humanoid. The robot tracks motions including turns, forward/backward locomotion, and squats under payloads up to 24kg.
tldr: HEFT is a teleoperation framework for full-size humanoids that uses Privileged Motion Guidance to handle noisy VR references and a Windowed Payload Curriculum to enable robust tracking under heavy payloads, demonstrated on a 175cm humanoid lifting up to 24kg.
tldr_zh: HEFT是一个用于全尺寸人形机器人的遥操作框架，通过特权运动引导处理有噪声的VR参考，并利用窗口式负载课程实现重负载下的鲁棒跟踪，在175cm人形机器人上展示了高达24kg的负载能力。
summary_zh: 通用运动跟踪与遥操作为实现可扩展的人形机器人技能获取提供了一条有前景的路径，然而现有框架大多在紧凑型平台上验证，或未涉及真实载荷交互，使得全尺寸人形机器人在真实载荷场景下的应用仍处于探索空白。扩展至全尺寸人形机器人面临两个叠加挑战：其较大的惯性和较窄的平衡裕度使得跟踪对商用VR追踪器产生的噪声、漂移及重定向误差高度敏感，而其载荷潜力却未能充分发挥。我们提出HEFT——一个面向重载荷全尺寸人形机器人的遥操作框架，旨在同时解决上述挑战。HEFT通过特权运动引导（PMG）从可部署的含噪VR参考中学习具有物理合理性的重构参考，并采用基于专家引导载荷上限的窗口式载荷课程（WPC）获取鲁棒的重载荷跟踪能力。我们将HEFT部署于L7（175cm身高、65kg体重的人形机器人）。该机器人在承载高达24kg载荷的条件下，可执行包含转向、前进/后退运动及深蹲在内的动作跟踪。

title: CoFL-S: Spatially Queryable Sector Flow Fields for Local Language-Conditioned Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation has increasingly emphasized high-level instruction reasoning, memory, global map construction, and instruction decomposition, while the low-level action representation remains comparatively underexplored. We propose CoFL-S, a low-level vision-language-action framework that predicts a language-conditioned flow field over the robot's local visible sector and generates continuous trajectories by rolling out the predicted field. To train this low-level representation, we convert each VLN-CE episode, originally a whole-episode instruction paired with an action sequence, into frame-level local supervision with aligned sub-instructions and matched action, trajectory, and dense flow-field targets. For evaluation, we introduce a continuous-time Habitat benchmark that isolates low-level action interfaces from instruction decomposition and executes all methods through a shared velocity-command controller, enabling decomposition-independent closed-loop comparison across different planner frequencies rather than fixed discrete forward-and-turn transitions in VLN-CE. Under matched encoders and training settings, CoFL-S consistently outperforms action-token and action-chunk baselines across planner frequencies in the continuous-time Habitat benchmark, and zero-shot real-world closed-loop deployment further shows its advantage over both baselines beyond simulation.
tldr: CoFL-S proposes a low-level vision-language-action framework that predicts language-conditioned flow fields over the local visible sector for continuous trajectory generation in language-conditioned navigation, outperforming action-token and action-chunk baselines in simulation and zero-shot real-world deployment.
tldr_zh: CoFL-S 提出了一种低层级视觉-语言-动作框架，通过在局部可见区域上预测语言条件流场来生成连续轨迹，在仿真和零样本真实世界部署中均优于动作标记和动作块基线。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航研究日益强调高层级指令推理、记忆、全局地图构建与指令分解，而低层级动作表示仍相对探索不足。我们提出CoFL-S，一种低层级视觉-语言-动作框架，该框架在机器人局部可见区域内预测语言条件化的流场，并通过展开预测流场生成连续轨迹。为训练这一低层级表示，我们将每个VLN-CE回合（原本为整段指令与动作序列配对）转换为帧级局部监督数据，包含对齐的子指令、匹配的动作、轨迹及稠密流场目标。在评估方面，我们引入连续时间Habitat基准，该基准将低层级动作接口与指令分解相隔离，并通过共享速度指令控制器执行所有方法，从而在不同规划器频率下实现与分解无关的闭环比较，而非VLN-CE中固定的离散前进-转向切换。在匹配编码器与训练设置条件下，CoFL-S在连续时间Habitat基准的各规划器频率上均持续优于动作令牌与动作分块基线，且零样本真实世界闭环部署进一步展示了其超越这两类基线的仿真外优势。

title: Bridge-WA: Predicting Where and How the World Changes for Robotic Action
summary: General-purpose vision-language-action models benefit from large vision-language priors, but effective manipulation also requires anticipating action-relevant scene changes. Existing world-action models often rely on large generative world models or dense future rollouts, which are expensive and spend capacity on visual details weakly coupled to control. We present Bridge-WA, a lightweight world-action framework that distills a frozen future-change teacher into three compact priors: future tokens for intended outcomes, change maps for intervention support, and motion-flow maps for local transition direction. A WorldBridge conditions the action transformer on these priors through multi-source attention memories and spatial-temporal biases, while the teacher model is removed at inference. Across VLABench, RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-Plus and real-robot evaluations, Bridge-WA improves task success, progress, and robustness, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution visual shifts. By focusing action generation on where and how the scene will change, Bridge-WA suppresses nuisance appearance factors such as background, lighting, and distractors, leading to better generalization without deployment-time dense future-image generation. Code and visualizations are available at: https://hcplab-sysu.github.io/BRIDGE-WA .
tldr: Bridge-WA introduces a lightweight world-action framework that distills a frozen future-change teacher into compact priors to improve action generalization for robotic manipulation, reducing reliance on expensive generative world models.
tldr_zh: Bridge-WA 提出了一种轻量级世界-动作框架，通过将冻结的未来变化教师模型蒸馏为紧凑先验，提升机器人操作的动作泛化能力，减少对昂贵生成式世界模型的依赖。
summary_zh: 通用视觉-语言-动作模型受益于大规模视觉-语言先验知识，但有效的操作还需要预测与动作相关的场景变化。现有世界-动作模型通常依赖大规模生成式世界模型或密集的未来状态展开，这些方法成本高昂，且将计算能力消耗在与控制弱耦合的视觉细节上。我们提出Bridge-WA，一种轻量级世界-动作框架，它将冻结的未来变化教师模型蒸馏为三种紧凑先验：用于表征预期结果的未来令牌、用于干预支持的变化图，以及用于局部过渡方向的运动流图。WorldBridge通过多源注意力记忆和时空偏置将这些先验信息输入动作变换器，而教师模型在推理阶段被移除。在VLABench、RoboTwin2.0、LIBERO-Plus以及真实机器人评估中，Bridge-WA提升了任务成功率、进度和鲁棒性，尤其在分布外视觉偏移场景下增益显著。通过将动作生成聚焦于场景将如何变化及在何处变化，Bridge-WA抑制了背景、光照和干扰物等无关外观因素，从而无需在部署时生成密集的未来图像即可实现更好的泛化性能。代码与可视化结果见：https://hcplab-sysu.github.io/BRIDGE-WA。

title: PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
summary: Manipulating fast and dynamically moving targets in unstructured 3D environments remains challenging for embodied AI. Existing visual-language-action models and world models struggle with accurate 3D geometry and physically meaningful forecasting. We propose PhysMani, a framework that couples a physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model with a future-aware action policy model. The world model learns a divergence-free Gaussian velocity field via online optimization for fast and physically grounded future dynamics prediction. The policy model integrates the predicted 3D scene future dynamics through a learnable token based cross-attention module. We introduce PhysMani-Bench, a dynamic manipulation benchmark with 16 tasks, and demonstrate a superior success rate over strong baselines in both simulation and real-world robot experiments.
tldr: PhysMani couples a physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model with a future-aware action policy to enable manipulation of fast dynamic objects in 3D environments, achieving superior success in both simulated and real robot tasks.
tldr_zh: PhysMani将基于物理原理的3D高斯世界模型与未来感知的动作策略相结合，实现了在3D环境中对快速动态物体的操控，在仿真和真实机器人任务中均取得了优异的成功率。
summary_zh:
摘要：
在非结构化三维环境中操控快速运动的动态目标对具身智能体而言仍具挑战性。现有视觉-语言-动作模型与世界模型难以实现精确的三维几何建模及具备物理意义的预测。我们提出PhysMani框架，该框架将基于物理原理的三维高斯世界模型与前瞻性动作策略模型相结合。世界模型通过在线优化学习散度为零的高斯速度场，实现快速且符合物理规律的未来动态预测；策略模型则通过基于可学习令牌的交叉注意力模块整合预测的三维场景未来动态。我们构建了包含16个任务的动态操控基准PhysMani-Bench，在仿真与真实机器人实验中均展现出优于强基线模型的成功率。

title: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently achieved strong progress in embodied intelligence. To reduce policy-call frequency while preserving temporal coherence, most generative policies adopt an action chunk mechanism, executing multiple future actions in an open-loop manner under a fixed action horizon. However, this "predict-then-blindly-execute" paradigm sacrifices closed-loop reactivity: in contact-rich physical interactions, even small local perturbations can rapidly amplify within the open-loop blind spot, leading to compounding errors and ultimately task failure. To address this limitation, we propose VLA-Corrector, a lightweight corrective inference framework for action-chunked VLA policies. Without modifying the backbone policy weights, VLA-Corrector introduces a lightweight Latent-space Vision Monitor (LVM) that continuously compares predicted and actual visual feature evolution, enabling online detection of visual dynamics deviations. Once persistent deviation is detected, the system triggers a truncation event, discards the remaining stale actions, and invokes corrective replanning via Online Gradient Guidance (OGG). The detect-and-correct mechanism of VLA-Corrector naturally induces an event-triggered adaptive action horizon: it preserves long-horizon execution when the current chunk remains reliable, and invokes short-horizon corrective replanning when execution begins to drift. In doing so, VLA-Corrector mitigates the trade-off imposed by static horizons between execution robustness and policy-call frequency. It can be integrated into different VLA models without further retraining the VLA backbone, interrupting compounding errors while preserving much of the efficiency benefit of action chunking and substantially improving robustness in long-horizon, contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr: VLA-Corrector proposes a lightweight framework for VLA policies that uses a Latent-space Vision Monitor to detect visual deviations and trigger corrective replanning, enabling adaptive action horizons to mitigate compounding errors in contact-rich manipulation.
tldr_zh: VLA-Corrector提出了一种轻量级框架，通过潜在空间视觉监控器检测视觉偏差并触发纠正性重规划，实现自适应动作视界，以减轻接触丰富操作中的累积误差。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型近期在具身智能领域取得了显著进展。为降低策略调用频率同时保持时间连贯性，大多数生成式策略采用动作分块机制，在固定动作视界内以开环方式执行多个未来动作。然而，这种"先预测后盲目执行"的范式牺牲了闭环响应能力：在富含接触的物理交互中，即使微小的局部扰动也可能在开环盲区内快速放大，导致误差累积并最终引发任务失败。为解决这一局限，我们提出VLA-Corrector——一种面向动作分块VLA策略的轻量级纠正推理框架。在不修改主干策略权重的前提下，VLA-Corrector引入轻量级潜空间视觉监控器（LVM），通过持续对比预测与实际的视觉特征演化，实现对视觉动态偏差的在线检测。一旦检测到持续性偏差，系统将触发截断事件，丢弃剩余的过时动作，并通过在线梯度引导（OGG）启动纠正性重规划。VLA-Corrector的检测-纠正机制自然催生了事件触发的自适应动作视界：当当前分块保持可靠时保留长视界执行，当执行开始偏离时则触发短视界纠正性重规划。通过这种方式，VLA-Corrector缓解了静态视界在执行鲁棒性与策略调用频率之间的权衡取舍。该框架可无缝集成至不同VLA模型中，无需重新训练VLA主干网络，既能中断误差累积，又能保留动作分块的大部分效率优势，显著提升长视界、富含接触的机器人操作任务的鲁棒性。

title: CoRe: Combined Rewards with Vision-Language Model Feedback for Preference-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reward design remains a central challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). Hand-crafted rewards are often difficult to specify and may lead to suboptimal policies, while learned rewards from preferences can suffer from inefficiency and unstable training. Inspired by the dual nature of human learning explored in cognitive science, we decompose rewards into two complementary components: Formal Rewards (FR), explicitly designed based on task knowledge, and Residual Rewards (RR), learned from observations to capture implicit and nuanced preferences. Based on this decomposition, we propose CoRe, a hybrid framework that integrates FR and RR with vision-language models (VLMs) feedback to achieve preference-aligned policies without human involvement. Our contributions are twofold: (1) We propose a Formal Reward Module (FRM) that leverages VLMs to iteratively design and optimize FR based on task knowledge and preference feedback, enabling the continual improvement of policy during training; (2) We introduce a Residual Reward Module (RRM) that learns RR from video-level preference by employing VLMs to generate preference labels and capturing nuanced rewards that complement FR, ensuring alignment with human intent. Through the synergy of FRM and RRM, CoRe enables the automatic construction of reliable rewards that are efficient and preference-aligned. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoRe outperforms existing approaches in terms of policy learning effectiveness and efficiency on ten robotic manipulation tasks in simulation and five real-worlds. Videos can be found on our project website: https://core-2026.github.io/
tldr: CoRe decomposes rewards into Formal Rewards and Residual Rewards, using VLMs to iteratively design the former and generate preference labels for the latter, achieving preference-aligned RL policies for robotic manipulation without human involvement.
tldr_zh: CoRe 将奖励分解为形式化奖励和残差奖励，利用 VLM 迭代设计前者并生成偏好标签以学习后者，从而在没有人工干预的情况下为机器人操作实现偏好对齐的强化学习策略。
summary_zh: 奖励设计仍然是强化学习中的核心挑战。手工设计的奖励往往难以精确指定，可能导致次优策略；而基于偏好学习的奖励则可能面临效率低下和训练不稳定的问题。受认知科学中人类学习双重本质的启发，我们将奖励分解为两个互补的组成部分：基于任务知识明确设计的正式奖励，以及通过观察学习以捕捉隐含和细微偏好的残差奖励。基于这一分解，我们提出了CoRe，一种混合框架，它将正式奖励和残差奖励与视觉-语言模型的反馈相结合，在无需人工参与的情况下实现与偏好对齐的策略。我们的贡献有两点：(1) 提出了正式奖励模块，利用视觉-语言模型基于任务知识和偏好反馈迭代设计与优化正式奖励，从而在训练过程中持续改进策略；(2) 引入了残差奖励模块，该模块通过使用视觉-语言模型生成偏好标签从视频级偏好中学习残差奖励，并捕捉补充正式奖励的细微奖励，确保与人类意图对齐。通过正式奖励模块与残差奖励模块的协同作用，CoRe能够自动构建高效且与偏好对齐的可靠奖励。大量实验表明，在十个模拟机器人操作任务和五个真实世界任务中，CoRe在策略学习效果和效率方面均优于现有方法。相关视频可在我们的项目网站获取：https://core-2026.github.io/

title: Imagining the Sense of Touch: Touch-Informed Manipulation via Imagined Tactile Representations
summary: Tactile sensing can substantially improve contact-rich robotic manipulation, yet its practical deployment remains limited by the fragility, calibration requirements, and maintenance burden of tactile hardware. This raises a fundamental question: can robots benefit from tactile knowledge without requiring tactile sensors at deployment? We present TacImag, a tactile imagination framework that predicts tactile observations from vision and proprioception and uses the generated signals to guide manipulation policies. Trained from paired visuotactile demonstrations, TacImag enables touch-informed manipulation using only visual observations at test time. We evaluate TacImag on six simulated and four real-world manipulation tasks. Across simulation and real-world experiments, imagined tactile observations consistently improve manipulation performance without requiring tactile hardware. In real-world experiments, imagined force fields improve contact-sensitive tasks by 44.4% on average, whereas imagined tactile images improve texture-sensitive tasks by 23.3%, revealing that the effectiveness of tactile imagination depends strongly on the relationship between tactile representation and task requirements. Our results further suggest that tactile imagination does not simply recover missing tactile measurements. Instead, it acts as a form of contact-aware supervision that transforms subtle visual interaction cues into representations that are easier for manipulation policies to exploit.
tldr: TacImag predicts tactile observations from vision and proprioception, enabling touch-informed manipulation policies without requiring tactile sensors at deployment, improving contact-sensitive tasks by 44.4% and texture-sensitive tasks by 23.3% in real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: TacImag 从视觉和本体感受预测触觉观测，使得在部署时无需触觉传感器即可实现触觉感知的操作策略，在真实世界实验中接触敏感任务提升44.4%，纹理敏感任务提升23.3%。
summary_zh: 触觉感知能够显著提升富含接触的机器人操作能力，但其实际部署仍受限于触觉硬件的脆弱性、标定需求及维护负担。这引发了一个根本性问题：若部署时无需触觉传感器，机器人能否从触觉知识中获益？我们提出TacImag——一种触觉想象框架，该框架从视觉与本体感知中预测触觉观测值，并利用生成的信号引导操作策略。通过配对视觉-触觉演示训练，TacImag在测试时仅需视觉观测即可实现具备触觉信息的操作。我们在六个仿真任务与四个真实世界操作任务上对TacImag进行了评估。仿真与真实实验均表明，想象触觉观测值无需触觉硬件即可持续提升操作性能。在真实实验中，想象力场使接触敏感任务的平均成功率提升44.4%，而想象触觉图像使纹理敏感任务的平均成功率提升23.3%，揭示出触觉想象的有效性高度依赖于触觉表征与任务需求之间的关系。我们的结果进一步表明，触觉想象并非简单地恢复缺失的触觉测量值，而是作为一种接触感知监督形式，将微妙的视觉交互线索转化为易于操作策略利用的表征。

title: One Demonstration Is Enough for Real-World Robotic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Learning effective robot control policies on physical hardware is challenging due to costly data collection and the difficulty of reward specification. Prior work has incorporated demonstrations into reinforcement learning (RL), yet existing approaches either require large numbers of demonstrations or depend on continuous human intervention during training. To address these limitations, we present AutoSERL, a framework that leverages a single demonstration to fully automate the intervention process in real-world robot RL. The framework includes three complementary mechanisms to accomplish certain tasks: a sliding window intervention mechanism that continuously guides exploration to prevent local optima and unsafe deviations, a safety recovery mechanism that detects and corrects failure states via predefined trajectory recovery points, and an intervention termination criterion that automatically disables guidance once the policy can independently complete the task, preserving its exploration advantage. We evaluate AutoSERL on six contact-intensive manipulation tasks across two robot platforms, spanning insertion, hanging, and hinge-based tasks. AutoSERL consistently outperforms SERL initialized with 20 demonstrations, behavior cloning, and MILES -- a dedicated one-shot imitation learning baseline -- across all tasks while matching HIL-SERL, achieves 100% success rate on insertion tasks, and demonstrates improved robustness to positional variations, all from a single demonstration. Code and videos are available on our project website: https://autoserl.github.io/.
tldr: AutoSERL uses a single demonstration to automate real-world robot reinforcement learning via sliding window intervention, safety recovery, and automatic termination, outperforming methods requiring many more demonstrations.
tldr_zh: AutoSERL利用单个示范通过滑动窗口干预、安全恢复和自动终止机制自动化真实机器人强化学习，在性能上超越需要更多示范的方法。
summary_zh: 在物理硬件上学习有效的机器人控制策略具有挑战性，原因在于数据采集成本高昂以及奖励函数难以设计。先前的研究已将示范融入强化学习，但现有方法要么需要大量示范，要么在训练过程中依赖持续的人工干预。为解决这些局限，我们提出AutoSERL框架，该框架利用单次示范即可完全自动化真实机器人强化学习中的干预过程。该框架包含三种互补机制以完成任务：滑动窗口干预机制持续引导探索以防止局部最优和不安全偏差，安全恢复机制通过预定义轨迹恢复点检测并纠正故障状态，以及干预终止准则——一旦策略能独立完成任务便自动禁用引导，从而保留其探索优势。我们在两个机器人平台的六项接触密集型操作任务上评估了AutoSERL，涵盖插入、悬挂及铰链类任务。在仅使用单次示范的条件下，AutoSERL在所有任务上均持续优于以20次示范初始化的SERL、行为克隆以及专用一次性模仿学习基线MILES，同时与HIL-SERL性能持平，在插入任务上达到100%成功率，并展现出对位置变化的更强鲁棒性。代码与视频见项目网站：https://autoserl.github.io/。

title: Multi-Rate Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Wall-Supported Bipedal Locomotion of Quadrupedal Robots
summary: This paper presents a novel layered planning and control framework based on multi-rate nonlinear model predictive control (MR-NMPC) that enables quadrupedal robots to perform hybrid bipedal locomotion with wall-assisted support in constrained environments. Real-time trajectory optimization for this locomotion presents significant challenges, as the controller must simultaneously plan for both the contact points and the continuous trajectories of the robot's center of mass (CoM) and orientation within the robot's nonlinear dynamics while accounting for unilateral contact constraints, underactuation, and the switching nature of the robot's dynamics. At the high level of the control framework, an MR-NMPC is proposed, which dynamically plans both the discrete-time trajectories of the contact points and the continuous-time trajectories of the CoM and orientation, using a single rigid body (SRB) dynamics model. By incorporating contact-point planning within the multi-rate optimal control framework, this approach enhances dynamic stability compared to heuristic foot placement strategies. At the low level of the control framework, a nonlinear whole-body controller (WBC) based on virtual constraints and a quadratic program enforces full-order dynamics and tracks the MR-NMPC references. The proposed approach is validated through extensive numerical simulations demonstrating the robust wall-assisted bipedal locomotion of a Unitree A1 quadrupedal robot on rough terrains and under external disturbances in a constrained environment. Comparative analysis shows that the proposed MR-NMPC achieves a 2.9 times higher success rate compared to conventional MPC with heuristic-based foot placement strategies in negotiating irregular terrain at high speeds.
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-rate nonlinear model predictive control (MR-NMPC) framework with integrated contact-point planning for wall-supported bipedal locomotion of quadrupedal robots, demonstrating improved stability and success rate in simulations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于多速率非线性模型预测控制的框架，通过集成接触点规划实现四足机器人的壁面辅助双足运动，仿真验证了其在粗糙地形和外部扰动下的稳定性和更高成功率。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于多速率非线性模型预测控制（MR-NMPC）的新型分层规划与控制框架，该框架使四足机器人能够在受限环境中借助墙壁支撑执行混合双足步态运动。实现此类步态的实时轨迹优化面临重大挑战：控制器需在考虑单向接触约束、欠驱动特性及动力学切换特性的前提下，同步规划机器人的接触点位置以及基于非线性动力学的质心（CoM）与姿态的连续轨迹。在控制框架的高层级，本文提出的MR-NMPC采用单刚体（SRB）动力学模型，动态规划接触点的离散时间轨迹与质心及姿态的连续时间轨迹。通过将接触点规划融入多速率最优控制框架，该方法相较于启发式落足点策略显著提升了动态稳定性。在控制框架的低层级，基于虚拟约束与二次规划的非线性全身控制器（WBC）强制执行全阶动力学并跟踪MR-NMPC参考轨迹。通过大量数值仿真验证了所提方法的有效性，结果表明Unitree A1四足机器人在粗糙地形及受限环境外部扰动下，能够实现稳健的墙壁辅助双足步态运动。对比分析显示，在高速穿越不规则地形时，所提出的MR-NMPC相较于采用启发式落足点策略的传统MPC，成功率提升了2.9倍。

title: CommonRoad-Game: A Human-in-the-Loop Simulation Framework for Autonomous Driving
summary: Motion planning algorithms should be evaluated in human-in-the-loop environments to ensure they produce safe and efficient behaviors during interactions. However, existing simulation platforms often rely on recorded datasets, lack dedicated interfaces for real-time human interaction, or remain weakly integrated with an autonomous driving ecosystem. Moreover, many human-in-the-loop simulators are computationally intensive by design, making them less suitable for rapid prototyping and flexible experimentation in early-stage autonomous driving research. To address these limitations, we present CommonRoad-Game, a lightweight human-in-the-loop simulation framework tightly integrated with the CommonRoad platform, focusing on the systematic testing of motion planners with human participation and the analysis of human driving behaviors in interactive scenarios. We introduce a multi-threaded architecture with a robust synchronization mechanism that aligns simulation time with wall-clock time, enabling deterministic and temporally consistent interaction between autonomous and human-driven vehicles. In addition, the framework provides a scenario generation module that records driving logs, allowing diverse and reproducible test cases to be constructed from human-in-the-loop experiments. Experimental results demonstrate that CommonRoad-Game achieves stable temporal synchronization, supports scalable multi-agent simulation, and seamlessly integrates CommonRoad-compatible motion planners to generate interactive driving scenarios. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Yunfei-Bi8/CommonRoad-Game.
tldr: CommonRoad-Game is a lightweight, human-in-the-loop simulation framework for autonomous driving that integrates with the CommonRoad platform, enabling real-time interaction between human drivers and motion planners with deterministic temporal synchronization.
tldr_zh: CommonRoad-Game 是一个轻量级、人在环路的自动驾驶仿真框架，与 CommonRoad 平台集成，支持人类驾驶员与运动规划器之间的实时交互，并实现确定性的时间同步。
summary_zh: 运动规划算法应在人在回路环境中进行评估，以确保其在交互过程中产生安全高效的行为。然而，现有仿真平台往往依赖录制的数据集，缺乏实时人机交互的专用接口，或与自动驾驶生态系统的集成度较弱。此外，许多人在回路模拟器在设计上计算密集，使其难以适用于自动驾驶早期研究中的快速原型开发与灵活实验。为解决这些问题，我们提出CommonRoad-Game，一个轻量级人在回路仿真框架，它与CommonRoad平台紧密集成，重点关注人类参与下运动规划器的系统性测试以及交互场景中人类驾驶行为的分析。我们采用多线程架构并配备稳健的同步机制，使仿真时间与挂钟时间对齐，从而实现自动驾驶车辆与人类驾驶车辆之间确定且时间一致的交互。此外，该框架还提供了一个记录驾驶日志的场景生成模块，能够从人在回路实验中构建多样化且可复现的测试案例。实验结果表明，CommonRoad-Game实现了稳定的时间同步，支持可扩展的多智能体仿真，并能无缝集成兼容CommonRoad的运动规划器以生成交互式驾驶场景。源代码已在https://github.com/Yunfei-Bi8/CommonRoad-Game公开。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Safety Guidance for Vision-Language-Action Models via Constrained Flow Matching
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising generalization capabilities across robotic manipulation tasks, yet their real-world deployment remains limited by the lack of effective safety measures. Specifically, existing safety measures only prevent collisions caused by the robot's next action. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic safety guidance mechanism for flow matching based VLAs that enables predictive collision avoidance. Flow matching based VLAs determine the next actions by predicting a trajectory (a sequence of actions) through an iterative neural flow matching process. Our method formulates safety enforcement as a minimum-norm constrained optimization problem that corrects safety violations during the denoising process of noisy intermediate trajectory predictions. By analyzing predicted trajectories and applying corrections during iterative denoising, our approach anticipates collisions before they become unavoidable. This interleaving of symbolic constraint satisfaction with neural trajectory generation enables predictive collision avoidance rather than reactive intervention. On the SafeLIBERO benchmark, our method achieves 82.8% collision avoidance and 81.6% task success, a 6.3% and 19.8% improvement respectively over single-step methods, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks where compounding distribution shift is most pronounced. Video demonstrations of our approach are included on our project page at https://willenglish.tech/SafetyGuidedFlowMatching/.
tldr: Proposes a neuro-symbolic safety mechanism for flow-matching-based VLA models that corrects unsafe trajectory predictions during the denoising process, achieving predictive collision avoidance and improved task success on the SafeLIBERO benchmark.
tldr_zh: 针对基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作模型，提出了一种神经符号安全机制，在去噪过程中修正不安全的轨迹预测，实现预测性碰撞避免，并在SafeLIBERO基准上提升了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中展现出了良好的泛化能力，但其实际部署仍因缺乏有效的安全措施而受到限制。具体而言，现有安全措施仅能防止由机器人下一步动作引发的碰撞。本文针对基于流匹配的VLA模型，提出了一种神经符号融合的安全引导机制，实现了预测性碰撞避免。基于流匹配的VLA模型通过迭代神经流匹配过程预测轨迹（一系列动作序列）来确定下一步动作。我们的方法将安全强制执行构建为一个最小范数约束优化问题，在噪声中间轨迹预测的去噪过程中修正安全违规行为。通过分析预测轨迹并在迭代去噪过程中施加修正，该方法能在碰撞变得不可避免之前提前预判。这种将符号约束满足与神经轨迹生成交错结合的方式，实现了预测性碰撞避免而非被动响应式干预。在SafeLIBERO基准测试中，我们的方法实现了82.8%的碰撞避免率和81.6%的任务成功率，相比单步方法分别提升了6.3%和19.8%，在复合分布偏移最为显著的长时域任务中获得了最大增益。项目页面（https://willenglish.tech/SafetyGuidedFlowMatching/）包含了本方法的视频演示。

title: Path-level Hindsight Instructions for Semantic Exploration in Vision-Language Navigation
summary: On-policy exploration is a crucial component for training robust Vision-Language Navigation agents, as it exposes the policy to a broader state distribution. However, such exploration inevitably leads to trajectories that deviate from expert demonstrations, resulting in a semantic mismatch between the executed visual stream and the original language instruction. In this work, we address this challenge by introducing Phi-Nav, a unified on-policy framework that leverages hindsight reasoning to align instructions with the agent's actual exploratory journey. Specifically, Phi-Nav operates through a three-stage dual-supervision cycle: 1) the agent performs oracle-guided on-policy exploration, sampling a trajectory while learning from expert action feedback, 2) a hindsight speaker synthesizes a path-level hindsight instruction grounded in the collected visual observations, and 3) the agent conducts a second imitation pass, treating the synthesized trajectory-instruction pair as an additional expert demonstration. Through this process, Phi-Nav bridges the critical semantic supervision gap inherent in on-policy methods, transforming semantically unlabeled movement into dense training signals. Evaluations on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks show that Phi-Nav yields competitive performance while requiring only a fraction of the expert demonstrations used by current baselines. These results underscore the necessity of semantic exploration in VLN, positioning Phi-Nav as an effective solution for training embodied agents with limited data.
tldr: Phi-Nav introduces a three-stage hindsight reasoning framework to bridge the semantic gap in on-policy exploration for Vision-Language Navigation, enabling agents to learn from their own exploratory trajectories with synthesized path-level instructions.
tldr_zh: Phi-Nav 提出了一种三阶段事后推理框架，以弥合视觉-语言导航中在线策略探索的语义鸿沟，使智能体能够从自身的探索轨迹中学习，通过合成的路径级指令进行训练。
summary_zh: 在策略探索是训练鲁棒视觉-语言导航智能体的关键组成部分，因为它能使策略暴露于更广泛的状态分布中。然而，这种探索不可避免地会导致轨迹偏离专家演示，从而在执行的视觉流与原始语言指令之间产生语义错配。在本工作中，我们通过引入Phi-Nav应对这一挑战，这是一种统一在策略框架，利用事后推理将指令与智能体的实际探索轨迹对齐。具体而言，Phi-Nav通过三个阶段的双重监督循环运行：1）智能体执行基于专家引导的在策略探索，在采样轨迹的同时从专家动作反馈中学习；2）一个事后说话者合成基于收集的视觉观测的路径级事后指令；3）智能体执行第二次模仿学习，将合成的轨迹-指令对视为额外的专家演示。通过这一过程，Phi-Nav弥合了在策略方法中关键的语义监督缺口，将无语义标签的运动转换为密集的训练信号。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上的评估表明，Phi-Nav在仅使用当前基线方法所用专家演示的一小部分的情况下，获得了具有竞争力的性能。这些结果强调了语义探索在视觉-语言导航中的必要性，并将Phi-Nav定位为在有限数据条件下训练具身智能体的有效解决方案。

title: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory
summary: We present WorldDirector, a highly controllable video world model framework designed for persistent dynamic object memory and unrestricted viewpoint exploration. Unlike existing world models that entangle physical dynamics with pixel rendering and rely on continuous visual observation to sustain motion, our framework explicitly decouples semantic motion orchestration from visual generation. By leveraging an LLM to coordinate 3D trajectories with camera movements and subsequently employing these orchestrated trajectories as control signals for video generation, our approach ensures strict physical logic and appearance stability, successfully preserving the exact visual identities of dynamic entities even when they re-enter the scene after prolonged periods out of view. Experimental results demonstrate that our method supports the synthesis of complex and extended events with unprecedented controllability and persistent dynamic object memory. Project Page: https://worlddirector.github.io/
tldr: WorldDirector introduces a framework that uses an LLM to coordinate 3D trajectories for controllable video world models, enabling persistent dynamic object memory and unrestricted viewpoint exploration.
tldr_zh: WorldDirector 提出了一个框架，利用大语言模型协调 3D 轨迹以实现可控视频世界模型，支持持久动态物体记忆和无限制视角探索。
summary_zh: 我们提出了WorldDirector，一种高可控性的视频世界模型框架，专为持久性动态物体记忆与无限制视角探索而设计。与现有将物理动态与像素渲染相纠缠、并依赖连续视觉观测维持运动的世界模型不同，本框架明确将语义运动编排与视觉生成解耦。通过利用大语言模型协调三维轨迹与摄像机运动，随后将这些编排好的轨迹作为视频生成的控制信号，我们的方法确保了严格的物理逻辑与外观稳定性，成功保留了动态实体在长时间离开视野后重新进入场景时的精确视觉身份。实验结果表明，本方法支持以空前的可控性与持久性动态物体记忆，合成复杂且持续时间较长的事件。项目页面：https://worlddirector.github.io/

title: Seek to Segment: Active Perception for Panoramic Referring Segmentation
summary: Existing referring segmentation models passively process static images captured from fixed perspectives, limiting their applicability in Embodied AI, where agents must perform active perception in the continuous 360$^\circ$ environments. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel task: Active Panoramic Referring Segmentation (APRS). In this setting, an agent is required to adjust its viewing direction ($Δθ, Δφ$) to explore the 360$^\circ$ environment, seeking the object specified by a user instruction for segmentation. To tackle this challenging task, we propose PanoSeeker, a memory-augmented agent for efficient APRS. Rather than relying on heuristic scanning, PanoSeeker integrates a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with EgoSphere, an explicit spatial visual memory. By progressively integrating sequential local observations into a unified 360$^\circ$ representation, EgoSphere enables the agent to plan efficient and non-redundant search trajectories. Once the target is found, the agent performs active viewpoint alignment and outputs the segmentation mask. Furthermore, we curate an expert-annotated search trajectory dataset with memory timelines for Supervised Fine-Tuning, followed by Reinforcement Learning post-training to explicitly optimize PanoSeeker's exploration efficiency. Extensive experiments on our newly established APRS benchmark demonstrate that PanoSeeker achieves superior search efficiency and segmentation accuracy, significantly outperforming adapted state-of-the-art baselines.
tldr: This paper introduces Active Panoramic Referring Segmentation (APRS), a new task for embodied agents to actively explore 360-degree environments via view adjustments to segment objects based on user instructions, and proposes PanoSeeker, a VLM-based agent with explicit spatial memory that achieves efficient search and accurate segmentation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出主动全景指代分割（APRS）新任务，要求具身代理通过调整视角主动探索360度环境以分割用户指令指定的物体，并设计了融合显式空间记忆的VLM代理PanoSeeker，实现了高效搜索与精准分割。
summary_zh: 现有的指代分割模型被动处理固定视角下的静态图像，限制了其在具身人工智能中的应用——这类场景要求智能体在连续360°环境中进行主动感知。为弥合这一差距，我们提出新任务：主动全景指代分割（APRS）。在该设定下，智能体需通过调整视角（Δθ, Δφ）探索360°环境，寻找用户指令指定的目标物体进行分割。为攻克这一挑战性任务，我们提出PanoSeeker——一种用于高效APRS的记忆增强型智能体。与依赖启发式扫描不同，PanoSeeker将视觉-语言模型（VLM）与显式空间视觉记忆EgoSphere相结合。通过将顺序局部观测逐步整合为统一的360°表征，EgoSphere使智能体能够规划高效且无冗余的搜索轨迹。一旦发现目标，智能体将执行主动视角对齐并输出分割掩码。此外，我们构建了包含记忆时间线的专家标注搜索轨迹数据集用于监督微调，随后通过强化学习后训练显式优化PanoSeeker的探索效率。在我们新建立的APRS基准上的大量实验表明，PanoSeeker在搜索效率和分割精度上均显著超越经过适配的最先进基线模型。

title: Open-Weather Robust 3D Detection via Dual-Critic Diffusion Alignment
summary: Robust 3D object detection under adverse weather remains a critical hurdle for autonomous driving. Despite progress with LiDAR-4D radar fusion, most methods are constrained by a closed-world assumption, implicitly requiring training and test weather to align in both type and severity. This premise fails in practice: the open-ended nature of weather, and even variations within a single type like rain, cause dramatically different LiDAR degradation patterns, leading to significant performance drops in unseen conditions. To address this, we present Dual-Critic Guided Diffusion Alignment (DCDA), a weather-agnostic framework that learns to recover degraded LiDAR features toward a clean manifold. Rather than modeling specific weather types, DCDA employs a 4D radar-conditioned diffusion process to progressively refine features, guided by two complementary critics. (i) A detection-guided critic, anchored by a pre-trained clean-weather model, ensures that the refined features retain object-level discriminability and localization accuracy. (ii) A weather adversarial critic enforces holistic distributional consistency with clean-weather representations. By aligning features through semantic and distributional constraints rather than explicit weather modeling, DCDA generalizes effectively to unseen weather types and severities without requiring paired data or weather labels. We further introduce a structured open-weather benchmark with held-out type-severity combinations and extensive experiments verify DCDA's advantages.
tldr: Proposes a dual-critic guided diffusion alignment framework (DCDA) that recovers degraded LiDAR features under diverse unseen weather conditions using 4D radar conditioning and both detection-guided and weather-adversarial critics, enabling weather-agnostic 3D detection for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种双鉴别器引导的扩散对齐框架（DCDA），利用4D雷达条件以及检测引导和天气对抗鉴别器，恢复在多种未见天气条件下退化的LiDAR特征，实现自动驾驶中的天气无关三维检测。
summary_zh: 在恶劣天气条件下的鲁棒三维物体检测仍是自动驾驶面临的关键挑战。尽管基于激光雷达与四维毫米波雷达融合的方法已取得进展，但多数方法受限于封闭世界假设，隐含要求训练与测试时的天气类型和强度保持一致。这一前提在实践中难以成立：天气的开放性本质，甚至单一雨雪天气内部的强度变化，都会引发截然不同的激光雷达退化模式，导致模型在未见过的天气条件下性能显著下降。为此，我们提出双判别器引导扩散对齐方法（DCDA）——一种与天气类型无关的框架，通过学习将退化激光雷达特征恢复至干净流形。不同于针对特定天气类型建模，DCDA采用四维雷达条件扩散过程逐步优化特征，并由两个互补判别器协同引导：（i）基于预训练干净天气模型的检测引导判别器，确保优化后的特征保持物体级可判别性与定位精度；（ii）天气对抗判别器，强制特征整体分布与干净天气表征保持一致性。通过语义与分布约束而非显式天气建模实现特征对齐，DCDA可在无需配对数据或天气标签的情况下，有效泛化至未见过的天气类型与强度。我们进一步构建了包含保留型-强度组合的结构化开放天气基准，大量实验验证了DCDA的优势。

title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models What to See and Where to Look
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing VLAs' training relies heavily on text-centric visual question answering and chain-of-thought reasoning data, which emphasizes linguistic reasoning rather than action-grounded planning. As a result, the learned representations capture semantic knowledge but lack spatial dependencies crucial for reliable trajectory prediction. We propose DriveTeach-VLA, a framework that explicitly teaches VLAs what to see and where to look. Driving-aware Vision Distillation (DVD) injects driving-specific perceptual priors into the vision encoder, while 2D Trajectory-Guided Prompts (2D-TGP) provide spatial conditioning aligned with feasible driving trajectories. Together, they form a vision-guided learning pipeline: what to see (DVD pretraining) - where to look (TGP-guided SFT) - how to act (TGP-guided GRPO). DriveTeach-VLA achieves the state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM and nuScenes. Our code is available at: https://github.com/ShivaTeam/DriveTeach-VLA.
tldr: DriveTeach-VLA enhances VLA models for autonomous driving by injecting driving-specific perceptual priors via DVD and providing spatial conditioning through 2D-TGP, achieving SOTA performance on NAVSIM and nuScenes.
tldr_zh: DriveTeach-VLA 通过DVD注入驾驶感知先验并使用2D-TGP提供空间条件，提升了VLA模型在自动驾驶中的性能，在NAVSIM和nuScenes上达到SOTA。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为端到端自动驾驶的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有VLA模型的训练严重依赖以文本为中心的视觉问答和思维链推理数据，这些数据强调语言推理而非基于动作的规划。因此，习得的表征虽能捕捉语义知识，但缺乏对可靠轨迹预测至关重要的空间依赖性。我们提出DriveTeach-VLA框架，该框架明确教导VLA模型“看什么”以及“往哪儿看”。驾驶感知视觉蒸馏（DVD）将驾驶特定的感知先验注入视觉编码器，而二维轨迹引导提示（2D-TGP）则提供与可行驾驶轨迹对齐的空间条件约束。二者共同构成视觉引导的学习流程：“看什么”（DVD预训练）→“往哪儿看”（TGP引导的监督微调）→“如何行动”（TGP引导的组相对策略优化）。DriveTeach-VLA在NAVSIM和nuScenes数据集上达到了最先进的性能。我们的代码开源在：https://github.com/ShivaTeam/DriveTeach-VLA。

title: MapDreamer: Aerial Imagery Conditioned Latent Diffusion for Lane-Level Map Generation
summary: High definition map generation is essential for autonomous driving, yet remains a labor-intensive process at scale. We present MapDreamer, a generative diffusion model that synthesizes lane-level vector maps with explicit topology directly from a single aerial image. MapDreamer learns a compact latent representation of lane centerlines and their topological relations using a variational autoencoder and predicts graphs with a transformer-based latent diffusion model. To align generated maps with the observed scene, we condition each denoising step on dense aerial features injected through cross-attention. To handle the varying number of lanes across scenes, we propose a lane cardinality module paired with background ghost lane latents, a learned buffer that prevents slot collapse during diffusion. Furthermore, we introduce a sliding-window global graph aggregation strategy that stitches local tiles into city-scale maps while preserving connectivity through encoded lane boundaries. Experiments on UrbanLaneGraph derived from Argoverse 2 show improved geometric and topological fidelity over non-generative baselines.
tldr: MapDreamer is a generative diffusion model that produces lane-level vector maps with topology from a single aerial image, improving map generation for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: MapDreamer是一种生成式扩散模型，能从单张航拍图像生成包含拓扑结构的车道级矢量地图，提升了自动驾驶地图生成的效率。
summary_zh: 高清地图生成对自动驾驶至关重要，但在规模化应用中仍是一项劳动密集型过程。我们提出MapDreamer，这是一种生成式扩散模型，能够直接从单张航拍图像合成具有显式拓扑结构的车道级矢量地图。MapDreamer利用变分自编码器学习车道中心线及其拓扑关系的紧凑潜在表示，并通过基于Transformer的潜在扩散模型预测图结构。为使生成的地图与观测场景对齐，我们在每个去噪步骤中通过交叉注意力注入密集的航拍特征。为处理不同场景下车道数量的变化，我们提出车道基数模块，并引入背景幽灵车道潜在变量——一种学习缓冲机制，用于防止扩散过程中出现槽位坍缩。此外，我们提出滑动窗口全局图聚合策略，该策略在通过编码车道边界保持连通性的同时，将局部瓦片拼接为城市规模的地图。在源自Argoverse 2的UrbanLaneGraph数据集上的实验表明，与无生成能力的基线方法相比，MapDreamer在几何与拓扑保真度方面均有提升。

title: Actuator Reality Shaping for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Learning
summary: Sim-to-real transfer in robot learning is often limited by discrepancies between the ideal actuator dynamics assumed during policy training and the nonlinear, hardware-dependent behavior of physical motors. While conventional approaches attempt to bridge this gap by increasing simulator fidelity through system identification, domain randomization, or learned actuator models, we introduce an alternative paradigm: actuator reality shaping. Instead of modifying the simulator to match the real world, our method shapes the closed-loop behavior of physical actuators to match the idealized second-order reference dynamics used in simulation. By equipping each joint with a two-degree-of-freedom feedforward--feedback controller, we decouple reference-response shaping from robust stabilization, thereby providing a standardized actuator interface for reinforcement learning policies. As a result, policies trained only with the prescribed reference model can be deployed zero-shot on real hardware without task-level fine-tuning or learned actuator models. We validate the approach on a single-joint high-gear-ratio servo under external loads and a 7-DOF robotic arm reaching task, where actuator reality shaping substantially reduces sim-to-real tracking error and improves zero-shot task performance compared with standard servo-control and representative real-to-sim-to-real baselines. We further demonstrate zero-shot transfer on a wheeled-legged robot driving over a slope and a humanoid robot walking, suggesting that actuator reality shaping can serve as a reusable interface for robot learning across diverse hardware platforms.
tldr: This paper proposes actuator reality shaping, which modifies the closed-loop behavior of physical actuators to match idealized simulation dynamics, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across diverse robots without task-level fine-tuning or learned actuator models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出执行器现实塑造方法，通过修改物理执行器的闭环行为以匹配仿真中的理想化动力学，无需任务级微调或学习型执行器模型，即可在多种机器人上实现零样本的仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 模拟到现实迁移在机器人学习中常受限于策略训练假设的理想执行器动力学与实际电机非线性、硬件依赖行为之间的差异。传统方法试图通过系统辨识、域随机化或学习型执行器模型来提升仿真器保真度以弥合这一鸿沟，而本文提出了一种替代范式：执行器现实塑形。我们的方法并非修改仿真器以匹配真实世界，而是通过塑造物理执行器的闭环行为使其匹配仿真中使用的理想化二阶参考动力学。通过为每个关节配备双自由度前馈-反馈控制器，我们将参考响应塑形与鲁棒镇定解耦，从而为强化学习策略提供标准化执行器接口。如此一来，仅使用预设参考模型训练的策略可直接零次部署于真实硬件，无需任务级微调或学习型执行器模型。我们在外部负载下的单关节高减速比伺服系统及七自由度机械臂抓取任务中验证了该方法——相较于标准伺服控制及具有代表性的实到仿再到实基线方法，执行器现实塑形显著降低了模拟到现实跟踪误差并提升了零次任务性能。我们进一步展示了轮腿机器人在斜坡行驶及仿人机器人行走中的零次迁移效果，表明执行器现实塑形可作为跨异构硬件平台的机器人学习可复用接口。

title: Guided Action Flow: Q-Guided Inference for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Flow-matching vision-language-action policies generate robot action chunks through an iterative transport process, creating an opportunity for test-time guidance without retraining the base policy. We study this opportunity in Guided Action Flow, an inference-time framework that keeps a pretrained SmolVLA policy frozen and uses a learned action-chunk critic to guide its reverse-time flow sampler. The critic is trained from real success and failure rollouts, can condition on task-description features from the frozen SmolVLA language pathway, and is used only through action gradients during sampling. We evaluate the approach on LIBERO manipulation tasks. A single-task critic improves success from 68.0% to 82.0% on one seed window and from 82.0% to 86.0% on another. A multi-family task-description critic improves validation success from 46.0% to 56.0%, while the locked held-out test gain is positive but modest, from 65.0% to 67.5%. These results support the feasibility of Q-guided inference for frozen flow-matching VLA policies, while showing that critic generalization and uncertainty-aware guidance remain the central bottlenecks.
tldr: This paper introduces Guided Action Flow, an inference-time framework that uses a learned action-chunk critic to guide the reverse-time flow sampler of a frozen flow-matching VLA policy, improving success rates on LIBERO manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Guided Action Flow，一种在推理时使用学习到的动作块批评器来引导冻结的流匹配VLA策略的逆向流采样器的框架，在LIBERO操作任务上提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 流程匹配的视觉-语言-动作策略通过迭代输运过程生成机器人动作块，这为在不重新训练基础策略的情况下进行测试时引导创造了机会。我们在引导动作流中研究这一机会，该框架是一种推理时框架，保持预训练的SmolVLA策略冻结，并利用学习到的动作块评判器来引导其反向时间流采样器。该评判器通过真实成功与失败展开数据训练，可基于冻结SmolVLA语言通路中的任务描述特征进行调节，且仅在采样过程中通过动作梯度发挥作用。我们在LIBERO操作任务上评估该方法。单任务评判器将某个种子窗口的成功率从68.0%提升至82.0%，在另一窗口上从82.0%提升至86.0%。多族任务描述评判器将验证集成功率从46.0%提升至56.0%，而锁定的保留测试集增益虽为正但较为有限，从65.0%提升至67.5%。这些结果证实了冻结流匹配VLA策略中Q引导推理的可行性，同时表明评判器泛化能力与不确定性感知引导仍是核心瓶颈。

title: Cross-Platform Control for Autonomous Surface Vehicles via Adaptive Reinforcement Learning
summary: Autonomous surface vehicles vary widely in hydrodynamic and actuation characteristics, yet most controllers are designed for single-platform deployment. We present an adaptive reinforcement learning approach for trajectory tracking that enables zero-shot cross-platform deployment using a single policy. Since the deployment platform's dynamics are unknown to the policy, we address cross-platform generalization with the standard partial-observability approach of conditioning on interaction history, employing a teacher-student architecture in which a learned module infers a latent representation of the platform dynamics. The policy is trained in simulation under randomized vessel dynamics and is deployed zero-shot to two real-world platforms without any fine-tuning, despite relying on a simple analytical dynamics model rather than a high-fidelity hydrodynamic simulator. In real-world experiments on two different platforms, the adaptive policy outperforms non-adaptive learning-based baselines by up to 58% in position mean absolute error while approaching the tracking accuracy of a platform-specific tuned controller.
tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive reinforcement learning approach for trajectory tracking in autonomous surface vehicles, enabling zero-shot cross-platform deployment via a teacher-student architecture that learns a latent representation of platform dynamics.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种自适应强化学习方法，用于自主水面车辆的轨迹跟踪，通过教师-学生架构学习平台动力学的潜在表示，实现零样本跨平台部署。
summary_zh: 自主水面航行器在水动力学和驱动特性上差异显著，但目前多数控制器针对单一平台部署设计。我们提出一种自适应强化学习方法用于轨迹跟踪，能够通过单一策略实现零样本跨平台部署。由于部署平台的动力学特性对策略而言是未知的，我们采用以交互历史为条件的标准部分可观测方法来解决跨平台泛化问题，并采用教师-学生架构，其中学习模块推断平台动力学的潜在表征。该策略在随机航行器动力学条件下的仿真环境中训练，并零样本部署至两个真实平台，无需任何微调——尽管其仅依赖简单的解析动力学模型而非高保真水动力学仿真器。在两个不同平台的真实实验中，自适应策略的位置平均绝对误差相比非自适应学习基线方法最高降低58%，其跟踪精度接近平台专属调优控制器的水平。

title: SPLC: Social Preference Learning for Crowd Robot Navigation
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) holds significant potential for crowd robot navigation in human-robot coexistence applications. However, the inherent complexity of pedestrian motion renders the design of effective reward functions for promoting socially compliant robot behaviors a persistent challenge. This paper proposes a Social Preference Learning for Crowd Robot Navigation (SPLC) algorithm to eliminate the need for detailed reward design. Its core innovation lies in the introduction of a social preference feedback mechanism to automatically generate preference data through principled preference evaluation criteria. By explicitly accounting for the intricacies of pedestrian dynamics, the pipeline mitigates the reward bias and facilitates the systematic quantification of broad social norms, thereby fostering socially compliant behaviors. Extensive experiments integrating SPLC with offline RL methods demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines across standard performance metrics. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the TurtleBot4 further validate the effectiveness of SPLC in practical human-robot coexistence settings. Our code and video demos are available at https://github.com/sklus949/SPLC.
tldr: This paper proposes SPLC, an offline RL algorithm that leverages a social preference feedback mechanism to automatically generate preference data for crowd robot navigation, eliminating the need for manual reward design and demonstrating improved performance in both simulation and real-world TurtleBot4 experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SPLC算法，通过社交偏好反馈机制自动生成偏好数据，无需手动设计奖励函数，实现更符合社交规范的机器人人群导航，并在TurtleBot4上验证了有效性。
summary_zh: 离线强化学习在人机共存应用中的群体机器人导航领域具有重要潜力。然而，行人运动的内在复杂性使得设计有效奖励函数以促进符合社会规范的机器人行为始终是一项挑战。本文提出一种用于群体机器人导航的社会偏好学习（SPLC）算法，以消除对精细奖励设计的依赖。其核心创新在于引入社会偏好反馈机制，通过原则性的偏好评价标准自动生成偏好数据。该框架通过显式考虑行人动力学的复杂性，能够缓解奖励偏差，并促进对广泛社会规范的系统性量化，从而激励符合社会规范的行为。将SPLC与离线强化学习方法相结合的广泛实验表明，该方法在标准性能指标上相较于最先进的基线方法取得了一致性改进。此外，在TurtleBot4上的真实世界实验进一步验证了SPLC在真实人机共存环境中的有效性。我们的代码与视频演示可在https://github.com/sklus949/SPLC获取。

title: A Reconfigurable Rocker-Bogie Robot for High Step Climbing and Turning
summary: This study proposes a reconfigurable rocker-bogie mechanism that achieves efficient turning motion with a small number of actuators while maintaining high step-climbing capability. By installing motors at the bogie joints and actively swinging up and down bogies, the system enables switching between four-wheel and six-wheel configurations. Omnidirectional wheels are mounted on the rear ends of the rockers, allowing smooth turning in the four-wheel configuration based on a differential-drive model. Experimental evaluation using a prototype robot demonstrated that the proposed mechanism achieves zero-radius turning at a speed more than five times that of a conventional rocker-bogie mechanism equipped with six non-steerable grip wheels, while requiring only approximately 17% of the total average wheel torque. In addition, the robot successfully climbed a 40 cm step with an average climbing time of 6.4 s, confirming its high turning and step-climbing performance.
tldr: This paper presents a reconfigurable rocker-bogie robot that actively controls bogie joints to switch between four-wheel and six-wheel configurations, enabling rapid zero-radius turning with low torque and high step-climbing ability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种可重构摇臂-转向架机器人，通过主动控制转向架关节在四轮和六轮构型间切换，实现低扭矩下的快速零半径转弯和高台阶攀爬能力。
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种可重构摇臂-转向架机构，该机构在保持高越障能力的同时，仅需少量执行器即可实现高效转向运动。通过在转向架关节处安装电机并主动控制转向架的上下摆动，系统能够实现四轮与六轮构型之间的切换。全向轮安装于摇臂后端，使机器人能在四轮构型下基于差速驱动模型实现平滑转向。基于样机进行的实验评估表明，与配备六个非转向抓地轮的常规摇臂-转向架机构相比，所提机构可实现零半径转向，速度提升五倍以上，且总平均车轮扭矩仅约为前者的17%。此外，该机器人成功攀越了40厘米台阶，平均攀越时间为6.4秒，验证了其出色的转向与越障性能。

title: Overthink-Triggered Slowdown Attacks on LVLM-Based Robotic Systems
summary:
Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have been increasingly integrated into robotic systems. However, these models may exhibit overthinking behaviors, where they generate excessively long reasoning traces, incurring an excessive inference time. This overthinking behavior poses a serious risk to robotic systems, as the adversary can deliberately trigger overthinking to slow down the decision making of a victim robotic system, causing a variety of safety issues (i.e., an overthinking-induced slowdown attack). To initiate this attack, an adversary can embed carefully crafted, human-readable scene text into the visual scene observed by a victim robotic agent, causing significant inference delays even under a strict black-box setting. Therefore, the embedded scene text serves as a significant "trigger" for the attack.
  This work systematically identifies and validates transferable triggers of overthinking in robotic systems by introducing a three-stage framework. First, we construct a diverse corpus of reasoning-intensive scene text and extract overthinking-correlated lexical features from short response prefixes. Second, we perform an efficient black-box search guided by a prefix-based proxy score while selectively confirming a small set of top candidates with full latency measurements. Third, we evaluate black-box transfer using a fixed pool of triggers on unseen images and multiple LVLMs, reporting latency amplification and attack success rates under standard thresholds. Across three representative LVLMs, all triggers yield slowdown ratios greater than 1.0x, with the strongest single-trigger case reaching 6.96x. The physical printing of the text trigger still causes up to 4.74x latency amplification. These results demonstrate that our discovered triggers are transferred between multiple LVLM models and consistently cause significant slowdowns in robotic systems.
tldr: This paper identifies and validates transferable scene-text triggers that cause overthinking-induced slowdown attacks on LVLM-based robotic systems, achieving latency amplification up to 6.96x in digital and 4.74x in physical settings.
tldr_zh: 本文发现并验证了可迁移的场景文本触发器，可对基于LVLM的机器人系统引发过度思考导致的减速攻击，在数字和物理环境下分别实现高达6.96倍和4.74倍的延迟放大。
summary_zh:
大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）正越来越多地被集成到机器人系统中。然而，这些模型可能表现出过度思考行为，即生成过长的推理链条，导致推理时间过长。这种过度思考行为对机器人系统构成严重威胁，因为攻击者可以故意触发过度思考，从而拖慢受害机器人系统的决策过程，引发各种安全问题（即过度思考引发的减速攻击）。为发起此类攻击，攻击者可将精心设计的、人类可读的场景文本嵌入到受害机器人智能体所观测的视觉场景中，即使在严格的黑盒设置下也能造成显著的推理延迟。因此，嵌入的场景文本成为该攻击的重要"触发器"。

本研究通过引入三阶段框架，系统性地识别并验证了机器人系统中过度思考的可迁移触发器。首先，我们构建了包含推理密集型场景文本的多样化语料库，并从短响应前缀中提取与过度思考相关的词汇特征。其次，我们以前缀代理得分为引导进行高效的黑盒搜索，同时通过完整延迟测量有选择地确认少量候选触发器。最后，我们在未见图像和多个LVLM上使用固定触发器池评估黑盒迁移性，报告标准阈值下的延迟放大倍数与攻击成功率。在三种代表性LVLM上，所有触发器均产生大于1.0倍的减速比，其中最强单触发器案例达到6.96倍。文本触发器的物理打印仍可导致高达4.74倍的延迟放大。这些结果表明，我们发现的触发器可在多个LVLM模型之间迁移，并持续对机器人系统造成显著减速。

title: SE(2) Navigation Mesh
summary: Global navigation for ground robots in complex multi-level environments requires representations that accurately capture traversable regions while enabling efficient path planning. Current approaches present key limitations: Point clouds and volumetric occupancy maps lack explicit surface structure for traversability estimation, whereas direct pathfinding on dense triangle meshes is computationally prohibitive. Navigation meshes mitigate these challenges through polygonal abstraction of the underlying mesh, but assume yaw-invariant traversability, rendering them unsuitable for non-circular robots in constrained spaces. We propose SE(2) Navigation Mesh (SE(2) NavMesh), a polygonal representation of traversable regions that encodes yaw-dependent traversability. Our method evaluates traversability using footprint masks and constructs a graph over yaw-specific layers with explicit translational and rotational connectivity. Grounded in this representation, we develop an A*-String Pulling-A* (ASA) pathfinding strategy that hierarchically optimizes robot position and heading. We also present an online method that incrementally updates the SE(2) NavMesh from streaming point clouds during concurrent geometry reconstruction. In simulation, the SE(2) NavMesh captures over 50% more traversable area than classical NavMeshes, and the SE(2) NavMesh + ASA pipeline consistently outperforms sampling-based baselines in constrained environments. Extensive real-world experiments on a physical robot validate real-time online generation and successful navigation across multiple environments.
tldr: Proposes SE(2) NavMesh, a polygonal representation for ground robot navigation that encodes yaw-dependent traversability, enabling pathfinding in constrained multi-level environments with the ASA planner.
tldr_zh: 提出了SE(2)导航网格，一种编码偏航依赖可遍历性的多边形表示，用于地面机器人在受限多层环境中的路径规划，并设计了ASA规划器。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在复杂多层环境中实现地面机器人的全局导航，需要既能准确刻画可通行区域、又能支持高效路径规划的表示方法。现有方法存在关键局限：点云与体素占据地图缺乏显式表面结构以评估可通行性，而直接在稠密三角网格上进行路径搜索则计算代价过高。导航网格通过多边形抽象底层网格来缓解这些问题，但其假设可通行性与偏航角无关，因此不适用于受限空间中的非圆形机器人。本文提出SE(2)导航网格（SE(2) NavMesh）——一种编码偏航相关可通行性的可通行区域多边形表示方法。该方法利用足迹掩膜评估可通行性，并在具有显式平移与旋转连接关系的偏航特定层上构建图结构。基于该表示，我们开发了A*-拉绳-A*（ASA）路径搜索策略，通过层次化优化机器人位置与朝向。同时提出一种在线方法，可在并发几何重建过程中根据流式点云增量更新SE(2) NavMesh。仿真实验表明，SE(2) NavMesh比经典导航网格多捕捉50%以上的可通行区域，且SE(2) NavMesh + ASA流水线在受限环境中始终优于基于采样的基线方法。在实体机器人上的大量真实环境实验验证了实时在线生成能力及跨环境导航的成功率。

title: BIFROST: Bridging Invariant Feature Representation for Observation-space Sim2Real Transfer
summary: Sim2real transfer for robot policy learning suffers due to mismatch between simulation and reality. Existing methods typically address each gap in isolation through separate adaptation modules, which are composed or layered when both gaps coexist. Yet the basis for attempting sim2real in the first place is that there is shared structure between a task in simulation and reality, where equivalent actions from equivalent configurations produce equivalent long term outcomes regardless of domain specific differences in rendering or physics. In this paper, we study whether we can identify and exploit this shared structure from raw observations to train a policy that enables zero shot transfer. We introduce BIFROST, which learns a shared history encoder on paired cross-domain data via cross-domain bisimulation objective: observation-action sequences leading to equivalent long-term behavior are mapped to nearby latent states, regardless of domain. Policies trained on these latent states in simulation transfer zero-shot to reality. We provide empirical evidence on sim2sim visual navigation and sim2real contact rich manipulation task and visual servoing task that BIFROST achieves effective transfer where domain adaptation and co-training baselines fail under both visual and dynamics domain gaps.
tldr: BIFROST learns a shared latent representation from paired sim-real observation-action sequences via cross-domain bisimulation, enabling zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for robot policies.
tldr_zh: BIFROST通过跨域双模拟目标从配对的仿真-真实观测-动作序列中学习共享潜在表示，实现机器人策略的零样本仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
基于仿真到现实迁移的机器人策略学习因仿真与现实之间的差异而受到影响。现有方法通常通过独立的适配模块分别应对每种差异，当两种差异同时存在时将这些模块组合或分层使用。然而，开展仿真到现实迁移的首要前提是：仿真与现实中的任务存在共享结构，即无论渲染或物理层面的领域差异如何，来自等价构型的等价动作都能产生等价的长期结果。本文研究能否从原始观测中识别并利用这种共享结构，以训练出支持零样本迁移的策略。我们提出BIFROST方法，通过跨域双模拟目标函数在配对跨域数据上学习共享历史编码器：将能导致等价长期行为的动作-观测序列映射到邻近的潜在状态，而不受领域限制。基于这些潜在状态在仿真中训练的策略可直接零样本迁移至现实。我们在仿真到仿真的视觉导航、仿真到现实的接触丰富型操作任务以及视觉伺服任务中提供了实证证据，表明BIFROST在视觉与动态领域差异同时存在时能实现有效迁移，而领域适配与协同训练基线方法则无法成功。

title: Repair the Amplifier, Not the Symptom: Stable World-Model Correction for Agent Rollouts
summary: As agent planning moves from short tool chains toward persistent workflows with thousands or tens of thousands of steps, failures will occur inside large planning graphs rather than in isolated predictions. Replanning the entire graph after every mistake is neither computationally realistic nor desirable: full-graph replay consumes large context budgets, exposes the LLM to many irrelevant symptoms, and can degrade long-context retrieval. This paper studies the missing component in such systems: a world-model corrector that repairs the failed planning graph in place. We compare two families of correctors. The first is the common engineering approach: scan nodes and edges, choose a suspicious local region, and ask an LLM to repair it. We implement strong engineering LLM correctors and find that they can help, especially when given very large contexts. The second family is our approach, WM-SAR (World-Model Subgraph Amplification Repair): instead of scanning for visible symptoms, it works backward from subgraph amplification, identifies the nodes and edges that keep re-amplifying error, and sends only that causal subgraph to the LLM. Across graph simulations and LLM repair experiments, WM-SAR substantially outperforms engineering correctors under realistic token budgets, achieves near-whole-graph stabilization with a compact region, and gives the LLM a cleaner repair target.
tldr: This paper introduces WM-SAR, a world-model corrector that repairs planning graphs by identifying and patching the causal subgraph responsible for error amplification, outperforming standard LLM-based symptom-driven repair under realistic token budgets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出WM-SAR，一种世界模型修正器，通过识别并修补导致错误放大的因果子图来修复规划图，在现实token预算下优于标准LLM症状驱动式修复。
summary_zh: 摘要：随着智能体规划从短工具链转向包含数千乃至数万个步骤的持久化工作流，失败将发生在大型规划图内部，而非孤立的预测中。在每次错误后对整个图进行重规划既非计算上的现实选择，也不可取：全图重放会消耗大量上下文预算，使大语言模型暴露于许多无关症状中，并可能降低长上下文检索能力。本文研究了此类系统中缺失的组件：一种能够原位修复失败规划图的世界模型修正器。我们比较了两类修正器。第一类是常见的工程方法：扫描节点和边，选择可疑的局部区域，并让大语言模型进行修复。我们实现了强大的工程化大语言模型修正器，并发现它们能够发挥作用，尤其是在给予非常大的上下文时。第二类是我们的方法——WM-SAR（世界模型子图放大修复）：它不扫描可见症状，而是从子图放大逆向工作，识别持续放大误差的节点和边，仅将该因果子图发送给大语言模型。通过图模拟和大语言模型修复实验，WM-SAR在现实的令牌预算下显著优于工程化修正器，能以紧凑区域实现接近全图稳定的效果，并为大语言模型提供更清晰的修复目标。

title: Search-based Testing of Vision Language Models for In-Car Scene Understanding
